## Why Genfare

As a partner to most transit agencies of all sizes across the U.S. and Canada for over 40 years,
Genfare is uniquely positioned to elevate public transit. Fare collection does not exist in a
vacuum, but rather is part of a larger strategy to improve the transit experience. Genfare can help
agencies achieve their goals, whether it’s through our solutions, our advocacy and thought
leadership, or even help applying for grants.

[About Us][62]

## Solutions

To appeal to riders, transit needs to accept whatever form of payment is in riders pockets and
deliver an integrated transit experience that connects every aspect of their journey. This requires
the latest smart hardware, open-architected software, and comprehensive services in a coordinated
suite of solutions customized for each agency’s unique fare collection system needs.

[cloud based software illustration]
How to improve scalability, performance, and stability

### Cloud-based software

Genfare is evolving the Genfare Link platform to a fully cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS)
solution; part of our ongoing commitment to provide reliable, modern, and future-ready fare
collection systems that meet the growing needs of our agencies and their riders. By moving to the
cloud, Genfare Link will deliver improved scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability for
your operations.

[Learn about cloud-based software][63]

[mobile ticketing illustration]
How to integrate fare collection across modalities

### Mobile ticketing

Riders want options. Open cloud-based systems paired with mobile trip planning and ticketing
platforms make it possible to not beat alternatives to transit, but to join them. Genfare’s mobile
ticketing solutions pair open APIs to leverage interoperability with microtransit and shared ride
providers with transit agency-branded platforms for a simplified rider experience.

[Learn about mobile ticketing][64]

[open payment illustration]
How to accept bank cards and mobile wallets

### Open payment

Adopting open payment lets riders pay with the contactless bank cards or mobile wallets they already
carry. Riders just get on the bus and tap their debit or credit card or scan the mobile wallet on
their smartphone or watch, and rest assured they are paying the right fare. Fast Fare® fareboxes can
be upgraded to add open payment capability, or an Open Link validator can be mounted next to the
farebox.

[Learn about open payment ][65]

[Fare collection illustration]
How to reduce the cost of fare collection

### Automated fare collection

One way to reduce the pressure of rising operating budgets is to invest capital funds in a fare
collection solution that lets you keep more of every dollar collected at the farebox. Genfare offers
cost-effective hardware and software that reduces the burden of fare collection by simplifying
revenue operations.

[Learn about automated fare collection][66]

How to connect systems for interoperability

### The Internet of Things

The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to the collective network of connected devices and the
technology that makes communication between devices and the cloud — or between devices themselves —
possible. With IoT-enabled capabilities, every aspect of a transit system and every user can be
connected by compatible hardware and software. The ways the IoT can be used in transit are
limitless.

[Learn about the Internet of Things][67]

[Retail solutions illustration]
How to support unbanked riders

### Retail solutions

Empowering equitable mobility means meeting riders where they are. While it’s crucial to continue to
accept cash at the farebox, cash-paying riders can’t take advantage of fare capping, transfers, and
other fare structures. Making it convenient for them to digitize cash to their choice of card-based
or account-based fare media makes the savings fare structures offer available to unbanked riders.

[Learn about retail solutions][68]

[fare collection security]
How to prevent theft of revenue and data

### Revenue and data security

Safety and security of revenue from the farebox to the counting room, and of data from the point of
sale to the bank, is a top priority of every Genfare solution. From pry-proof steel fareboxes to
durable vaults, and from tokenization of bank account information to redundancies of AWS data
warehouses, we take every precaution to earn your transit agency’s peace of mind knowing every
transaction is secure.

[Learn about revenue and data security][69]

collection systems that meet the growing needs of our agencies and their riders. By moving to the
cloud, Genfare Link will deliver improved scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability for
your operations.

[Learn about cloud-based software][63]

[mobile ticketing illustration]
How to integrate fare collection across modalities

### Mobile ticketing

Riders want options. Open cloud-based systems paired with mobile trip planning and ticketing
platforms make it possible to not beat alternatives to transit, but to join them. Genfare’s mobile
ticketing solutions pair open APIs to leverage interoperability with microtransit and shared ride
providers with transit agency-branded platforms for a simplified rider experience.

[Learn about mobile ticketing][64]

[open payment illustration]
How to accept bank cards and mobile wallets

### Open payment

Adopting open payment lets riders pay with the contactless bank cards or mobile wallets they already
carry. Riders just get on the bus and tap their debit or credit card or scan the mobile wallet on
their smartphone or watch, and rest assured they are paying the right fare. Fast Fare® fareboxes can
be upgraded to add open payment capability, or an Open Link validator can be mounted next to the
farebox.

[Learn about open payment ][65]

[Fare collection illustration]
How to reduce the cost of fare collection

### Automated fare collection

One way to reduce the pressure of rising operating budgets is to invest capital funds in a fare
collection solution that lets you keep more of every dollar collected at the farebox. Genfare offers
cost-effective hardware and software that reduces the burden of fare collection by simplifying
revenue operations.

[Learn about automated fare collection][66]

How to connect systems for interoperability

### The Internet of Things

The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to the collective network of connected devices and the
technology that makes communication between devices and the cloud — or between devices themselves —
possible. With IoT-enabled capabilities, every aspect of a transit system and every user can be
connected by compatible hardware and software. The ways the IoT can be used in transit are
limitless.

[Learn about the Internet of Things][67]

[Retail solutions illustration]
How to support unbanked riders

### Retail solutions

Empowering equitable mobility means meeting riders where they are. While it’s crucial to continue to
accept cash at the farebox, cash-paying riders can’t take advantage of fare capping, transfers, and
other fare structures. Making it convenient for them to digitize cash to their choice of card-based
or account-based fare media makes the savings fare structures offer available to unbanked riders.

[Learn about retail solutions][68]

[fare collection security]
How to prevent theft of revenue and data

### Revenue and data security

Safety and security of revenue from the farebox to the counting room, and of data from the point of
sale to the bank, is a top priority of every Genfare solution. From pry-proof steel fareboxes to
durable vaults, and from tokenization of bank account information to redundancies of AWS data
warehouses, we take every precaution to earn your transit agency’s peace of mind knowing every
transaction is secure.

Masabi is leading the movement away from closed legacy fare collection systems. We’re redefining the
entire approach to fare collection with our Fare Payments-as-a-Service model, delivering agencies
the latest ticketing innovations quickly and cost-effectively, revolutionizing the passenger
experience.

Elevate your transit network with Masabi’s contactless ticketing platform. Provide unparalleled
convenience while lowering fare collection costs. Our solutions ensure equity for all riders and
offer flexible payment options resulting in **increased ridership**, **reduced dwell times**, and

transportation is the first choice for everyone.

# Transforming Fare Payments

with Enterprise-Ready, Open Platform Solutions

### **Pioneering a New Era in Fare Payments**

Masabi is leading the movement away from closed legacy fare collection systems. We’re redefining the
entire approach to fare collection with our Fare Payments-as-a-Service model, delivering agencies
the latest ticketing innovations quickly and cost-effectively, revolutionizing the passenger
experience.

[ Schedule a Demo ][107]
[home page contactless fare payments][home page contactless fare payments]

###### **Trusted by 200 Agencies and Operators**

[ Customers ][108]

## **Transform Your Transport System with Contactless Ticketing**

Elevate your transit network with Masabi’s contactless ticketing platform. Provide unparalleled
convenience while lowering fare collection costs. Our solutions ensure equity for all riders and
offer flexible payment options resulting in **increased ridership**, **reduced dwell times**, and
greener, **less congested cities**.

[COTA Account-Based Ticketing Case Study][COTA Account-Based Ticketing Case Study]
[Uber Ticketing RTC Case Study][Uber Ticketing RTC Case Study]

## **Empowering Connected Communities**

Masabi powers a truly connected transit ecosystem, making Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) a reality.
Integrate seamlessly with various transport modes to enable smooth, **connected journeys for all**,
fostering vibrant communities and sustainable cities. Let’s create a future where public
transportation is the first choice for everyone.

## **Enterprise-Ready**

## Account-Based Ticketing Platform

Justride is a robust, secure, and reliable Account-Based Ticketing platform delivering Smart Card,
Open Payment (cEMV), Mobile Ticketing, Barcode and Mobility-as-a-Service solutions via a
comprehensive suite of APIs and SDKs making it easy to launch, integrate, and operate.

[ Discover Justride ][109]
[Passenger with Mobile Ticketing App][Passenger with Mobile Ticketing App]

# **Platform for Everyone**

Justride is a pre-integrated platform, powering off-the-shelf & modular fare payment solutions. With
our **open ecosystem** and **best-in-class partner network, **whatever you need and whatever your
size, we have the platform that’s right for you.

[Justride Contactless Ticketing Solution][Justride Contactless Ticketing Solution]

### **Express Fare Solutions**

Justride is available as a ready-to-go turnkey contactless ticketing solution giving you everything
you and your passengers need. The platform comes pre-integrated with validators, apps, payment
gateways, and acquiring banks.

[ Express ][110]
[Enterprise Solutionss Masabi Ticketing System][Ent

# You don't know us?
# We bet you do!

The Scheidt & Bachmann Group is one of the leading providers of innovative system solutions for
mobile living. With our unique portfolio, we support a wide range of transport systems, ensuring
that millions of people and goods stay in motion worldwide. Our smart solutions are encountered
daily and almost everywhere: when parking, refueling, or charging, when using public transport, or
traveling by rail.

In collaboration with mobility providers around the globe, we are committed to making mobility as
convenient and sustainable as possible.

[Learn more about us][118]

## We shape the
## **future of mobility**

# What makes us special?

We invest in generations, not in quarters.

Our success as one of the global market leaders in Parking Solutions, Signalling Systems, Fare
Collection Systems, and Energy Retail Solutions is driven by the dedication and expertise of our
employees. We foster both through diverse career opportunities, exciting projects, and flat
hierarchies. Providing freedom to develop and realize innovative ideas is a given for us.

# You don't know us?
# We bet you do!

The Scheidt & Bachmann Group is one of the leading providers of innovative system solutions for
mobile living. With our unique portfolio, we support a wide range of transport systems, ensuring
that millions of people and goods stay in motion worldwide. Our smart solutions are encountered
daily and almost everywhere: when parking, refueling, or charging, when using public transport, or
traveling by rail.

In collaboration with mobility providers around the globe, we are committed to making mobility as
convenient and sustainable as possible.

[Learn more about us][118]

## We shape the
## **future of mobility**

# What makes us special?

We invest in generations, not in quarters.

Our success as one of the global market leaders in Parking Solutions, Signalling Systems, Fare
Collection Systems, and Energy Retail Solutions is driven by the dedication and expertise of our
employees. We foster both through diverse career opportunities, exciting projects, and flat
hierarchies. Providing freedom to develop and realize innovative ideas is a given for us.

###### Automated Fare collection is a smart payment method for intelligent public transport systems 
######   using the   pre paid cards or tickets to pass through the electronic systems or gates to
###### allow commuters to access to and from the various transportation modes such as Railways,
###### Buses, Metro, Taxi, Parking etc..

###### Transportation payments

###  

### AFC Systems - Who We Are?

 

###### We are the solution provider for complete Automated Fare Collection Systems (AFC) to manage
###### the transportation devices, Device Operating Data (DoD), manage the process of the
###### transaction files for settlement fees, charges and revenue allocation for the various
###### transport and non transport operators and interface between different transportation levels
###### as a Central Clearing House.

## Two Strengths. One Company.

Aurotoshi brings together Toshi Automatic Systems, a pioneering Indian manufacturer with over three
decades of expertise in entrance automation systems and loading bay products, and Aurionpro
Solutions, an NSE/BSE-listed global technology enterprise specializing in transit and digital
infrastructure. Together, they have created a unique combination of manufacturing excellence and
technology integration, establishing Aurotoshi as a leading Entrance Automation Company in India.

Since joining forces in 2021, the vision has been to deliver world-class entrance automation
systems, access control systems, and fare collection solutions for modern infrastructure. Today,
Aurotoshi is a preferred partner for urban transit operators across India, with projects across
Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, Kanpur, Nagpur, and other major cities. Every solution is
designed, built, installed, and serviced in India, ensuring quality, reliability, and long-term
support without intermediaries.

## We Don’t Disappear After Installation

Most automation providers complete the installation and move on. At Aurotoshi, our commitment
extends far beyond deployment. We provide structured AMC contracts, rapid breakdown support,
preventive maintenance, and timely spare parts availability to ensure your entrance automation
systems, public safety solutions, and transit infrastructure continue to perform at their best
throughout their lifecycle
* **24-hour breakdown response** for critical industrial and transit equipment
* **Annual maintenance contracts (AMC)** across all three verticals
* **In-house spare parts** dispatched from our Ghaziabad manufacturing facility
* **Trained service engineers** across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, and Pune
* **Preventive maintenance schedules** to avoid unplanned downtime

## Ready to Transform Your Project?

Whether you're planning a new facility or upgrading an existing one, our engineering team is ready
